SD37-012.name: Advent Draw
SD37-012.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 7000 BP. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Spirit card with [Advent] to your Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

SD37-014.name: Evolution Attack
SD37-014.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. When any Spirit/Ultimate is destroyed by this effect, refresh one of your [During Advent] Spirits, and during this turn, that Spirit gains an extra Red symbol.

SD37-003.name: Heatedge Wolf
SD37-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

SD37-002.name: Pile-Puma
SD37-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV2][LV3]
The amount of cards revealed by your [Bombardment]/[Twinkle Bombardment] becomes three.

SD37-013.name: Red Lightning
SD37-013.effect:

SD37-004.name: Royal Tiger Kid
SD37-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Spirit card with [Advent] from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8858.name: The BombardmentGodKing Revol-Tiger-Zero
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8858.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Emperor Beast & Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3] [Bombardment-Zero] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is an "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. When it is a Spirit card with [Advent], instead, send two opposing Lives to their Reserve. Add the revealed card to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11592.name: The NovaCannonEmperor Evol-Tiger
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11592.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 13000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] [Twinkle Bombardment] (When Attacks)
If you control any [During Advent] Spirit, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. For each "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card among them, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11864.name: The Red Holy Relic

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits gain +3000 BP. Also, all your [During Advent] Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirits gains +4000 BP.

Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates, up to a total of 20000 BP.
